passages.title: A Weekend at the Local Food Market
passages.text: Last Saturday, I decided to visit the new food market in the town square. I had heard many people talking about the fresh produce and the friendly atmosphere. (1) __________ I arrived just as the stalls were opening, so it was still quite quiet. The smell of freshly baked bread and roasted coffee beans was everywhere. I walked slowly past the different stalls, looking at the colorful vegetables and local cheeses. (2) __________ I eventually stopped at a small stall that sold homemade honey. The owner was very kind and let me taste three different types before I made my choice. After buying a jar of honey, I felt hungry and looked for something to eat. (3) __________ It was filled with fresh herbs and local vegetables. It was probably the best lunch I have had in a long time. While I was eating, a local band started playing some relaxing music near the fountain. (4) __________ Many families were sitting on the grass, enjoying the sunshine and the music. It was a perfect way to spend a Saturday morning. I will definitely return next weekend to try some of the other delicious treats. (5) __________ It is a great addition to our town and I hope it stays for a long time.

passages.title: Options
passages.text:
A) I found a small stand that served warm vegetable pies.
B) It was much busier than I had expected.
C) I was surprised by how many different items were available.
D) The market has become a very popular place for everyone.
E) There were so many things to see that I didn't know where to start.
F) The melody made the whole experience even more enjoyable.
G) I really recommend visiting if you have the chance.
H) I made sure to bring a large bag to carry everything home.

questions.question: Choose the best sentence (A-H) for gap 1.
questions.explanation: The sentence provides a natural transition to the description of the variety of items seen.
options: A) In the end I bought a warm vegetable pie from a stall near the entrance.
B) Unfortunately, the rain started before I could finish my coffee.
C) There was far more choice than I had expected from such a small market.
D) Several of my neighbours have told me they now shop there every week.
E) I decided to go early so that I could see everything before the crowds arrived.
F) The music made the whole square feel even more welcoming.
G) The market is only open on the last Sunday of every month.
H) I had never bought anything directly from a farmer before.
